views.front: The rounded kettle lid and bowl form a continuous recognizable barbecue; the small damper is now fully visible on the dome.
views.rear: The smooth rear lid, handle and wheel frame retain their original layout without new surface intersections.
views.detail: Full-size inspection shows the damper seated to the curved lid rather than half buried. Four restrained dark vent marks remain legible; they are stylized solid marks.
views.underside: The lower bowl, ash cup, wheels and three supports remain readable and attached from beneath.
views.clay: The neutral silhouette shows the improved smooth spun shell with a closed rim and thin seated vent detail.
